items.title: What Could Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) FDA Cancer Approval Change For Investors?
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) received FDA accelerated approval for RYBREVANT FASPRO for advanced head and neck cancer in adults. The therapy is cleared for recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma after platinum chemotherapy and anti-PD-(L)1 treatment. RYBREVANT FASPRO is described as a first in class, dual targeted option for patients with limited second line treatment choices. This accelerated approval of RYBREVANT FASPRO for second line head and neck cancer is a shift...

items.title: How Much You’d Need in Dividend Stocks to Generate $5,000 a Month in Passive Income
items.summary: The price tag on a $60,000 dividend paycheck swings by nearly $2 million depending on the yield you chase. Higher payouts shrink the bill, but one tier hides a trap that can gut your income when a cut arrives.

items.title: Leaving a Roth IRA to Your Kids? Why Dividend Stocks Make the 10-Year Rule Work for Them
items.summary: One stock in a six-pack of blue-chip dividend payers drives nearly two-fifths of the tax bill on an inherited portfolio, and it belongs somewhere else entirely. Your kids could pay for that mistake for decades.
